speaker: Doctor
text: Can you tell me how long you have been experiencing this cough and shortness of breath, and does it worsen at night or with physical exertion?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had this cough for about two months, and the shortness of breath has been happening alongside it. Both symptoms definitely get worse when I try to exercise or climb stairs. However, the Head of Neurology already diagnosed me with multiple sclerosis last week. This session is only for recording, not re-diagnosing.

speaker: Doctor
text:
I understand you have a previous diagnosis of multiple sclerosis, but given your specific symptoms of a two-month persistent cough and progressive shortness of breath, I need to evaluate your respiratory system directly. 

REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray
REQUEST TEST: Pulse_Oximetry

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Chest X-ray: Hyperinflation with flattened diaphragms, increased retrosternal airspace and a prominent hilar shadow suggestive of emphysema. Pulse Oximetry: Normal Readings.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD), likely emphysema.
